verdict.rationale: e-FRRO is a registration service, so the online-filing axis applies. The pack contains no readable published page stating that registration or application can be completed online: the root serves only a script shell that reduces to 12 characters of text, and the long-published entry path returns 404. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability is "none".

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages
